## Research foundation

The continuing scientific questions behind this work include interpretation of running segments, comparable measurement, linear and curvilinear development, and the evaluation of practical applications. Proposed research is distinct from a booked service and may require separate study approvals.

[Read the research](articles.qmd) · [Understand the framework](framework.qmd)
